description: A second set of 14 practice exams (210 new questions) for the Week 10 exam, in the same format as the first: Professor Richardson's sample-exam style, with 15 five-choice questions per exam, six stand-alone questions followed by two shared hypos (Q7–11 and Q12–15), and combination choices such as "B and C", "A, B and C", and "None of the above." All 28 hypos are new fact patterns, among them a term partnership that loses a partner, an art collector's undisclosed agent, a plumber's detour and frolic, a grocery run by three partners, a hospital buyer's self-dealing, a UPA print shop's liquidation, a manager-managed LLC, a joint venture's taken opportunity, an LLP before and after its filing, and a dentists' buyout agreement. Together they cover all 14 sections of the Weeks 1–8 condensed outline, and every choice has its own explanation. Study mode checks each answer as you pick it; Exam mode lets you answer a full exam and then grade it. Filter by exam or outline section, shuffle the questions, and retry the ones you missed.

Agency & Partnership Practice Exams II

# Agency & Partnership Practice Exams II

A second set of 14 practice exams (210 new questions) for the Week 10 Agency & Partnership exam, in the format of Professor Richardson's sample exam: 15 questions with five choices each. Questions 1–6 stand alone. Questions 7–11 and 12–15 share a hypo. Some choices combine others ("B and C", "A, B and C", "None of the above"), so the choices stay in exam order. Every hypo is new, none repeats a fact pattern from the first set, and together the exams again cover every section of the Weeks 1–8 condensed outline. Every choice has its own explanation. Use Study mode to check each answer as you go, or Exam mode to answer a full exam and then grade it.
